id./param/scenario/cs/a_180_cs_080.pack|cs_: "So this is the Heart of Yggdrasil... It's enormous.
"It holds all the world's life. It has to be this big.
"Standing this close, it's a little scary. It feels like it could swallow me up.
"Yow! What was that!? It zapped me!
"Hm. Only one who bears the Luminary's mark can enter the Heart, it seems.
"And that is what dispels the darkness... Surely the Sword of Light.
"Now, {var:1}! Take the Sword of Light from within the Heart!
"You can do it! You alone can take it!
"Dull-witted vermin. Not one of you noticed me tailing you.
"Such unseemly behavior, Princess Jade. Nothing you do can harm me...
"Tremble with joy! You shall be the sacrifices that pave the way for my ambition!
"Luminary! And all who stand with the Luminary! I shall make the Tree of Life your gravestone!"
